records.text: Matt Taibbi has remained silent about Gaza and became defensive when people pressed him to speak.
records.speaker: Ana Kasparian

appearances.snippet: exposing the truth to people. But for whatever reason, he's just decided to remain silent. And when people kind of started to nudge him about it, he continued to be silent and then defensive.

verification.notes: Taibbi was not wholly silent: he published an essay specifically about Gaza. The same essay is defensive in tone and responds to criticism over his relative silence, so the statement captures the controversy but overstates it as total silence.

sources.title: In Gaza, Does Silence Equal Violence?
sources.relevance: Taibbi own Gaza essay directly bears on both the silence and defensiveness claims.

records.text: Um, I don't talk about him that often because it really does break my heart. I, he was the best reporter after the 2008 economic collapse, Matt Taibbi. He hasn't taken the wrong position. He's just decided to be silent for whatever reason.
records.speaker: Ana Kasparian
